randomization.selected_driver: frosted copper cooling clamp on one edge and warm ceramic ring on the opposite edge
randomization.randomized_complex_concept: An adult materials scientist in a storm-battered orbital greenhouse presents a transparent cylindrical quartz ampoule where amber parent fluid, pale crystalline nuclei, and a cold-to-warm solidification front coexist in one frame.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: The same bounded specimen must simultaneously show parent material, multiple new-phase nuclei, a coherent driving gradient, and one continuous growing interface as physical material structure.
perceptual_contract.global: The reference-guided adult and the complete experiment are jointly legible, while the phase-transition mechanism remains the dominant foreground event.
perceptual_contract.regional: A left cold clamp and right warm ring own one directional gradient through the tube; the frosted new-phase region, amber parent fluid, nuclei, and interface remain spatially connected.
perceptual_contract.local: At native scale, separated pale nuclei, condensation, frost texture, parent fluid, and the irregular interface can be distinguished without relying on prompt text.

reference.boundary: Observable adult appearance only: long center-parted dark wavy hair, dark eyes, softly arched brows, adult impression, and broadly comparable face proportions. No identity, biometric, protected-trait, health, personality, occupation, or same-person inference.
